div.div: قُثَاثٌ [and ↓ قُثَاثَةٌ ] Household-goods, or utensils and furniture; (M, O, K;) and the like. (M.) One says, جَاؤُوا بِقُثَاثِهِمْ and ↓ بِقُثَاثَتِهِمْ [lit. They came with their household-goods, &c.,] meaning they left not anything behind them. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
